Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners files a memo seeking withdrawal of the Criminal Petition.

The memo so filed reads as follows:
"The Petitioners submits that, in view of the settlement between the petitioners and the 2nd respondent-complainant before the trial court the above petitioner does not survive for consideration.
Hence the petitioner may kindly be permitted to withdraw the above petition as not pressed.
In terms of memo, the Criminal Petition is disposed as withdrawn.

Sd/-
(M.NAGAPRASANNA) JUDGE CBC List No.: 2 Sl No.: 81 Rehamathulla Khan vs State By on 25 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177063065/
